source: Chapter 678: Absurd Orgy
target: Capitulum 678: Orgia Absurda

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpres: CKtalon

source: Amandina scrutinized the naked preacher, Cali, from head to toe.
target: Amandina praedicatorem nudum, Cali, a capite ad pedes perscrutavit.

source: Her gaze eventually settled on Robert, her fiance, kneeling beside him.
target: Aspectus eius tandem in Roberto, sponsulo suo, in genu flectente iuxta eum consedit.

source: The lad with brownish-yellow hair, his skin pale-white as if he had not been exposed to the sun for a long time, had abandoned his usual cold demeanor.
target: Puer, cui crines sunt flavo-brunnei, cutis pallide alba, quasi diutius solis fulgore caruisset, habitum suum frigidum consuetus reliquit.

source: He was equally excited, but he controlled himself and patiently waited for the padre to complete his preaching.
target: Eodem modo excitatus erat, sed se continuit et patienter exspectavit ut Padre praedicationem suam perficeret.

source: The other naked men grew increasingly restless, gradually stirring.
target: Alii viri nudi paulatim inquietiores fiebant et gradatim se movebant.

source: However, it was evident that they held Padre Cali in high esteem.
target: Sed manifeste patebat eos Padre Cali summo honore habere.

source: Despite their disintegrating self-control, they refrained from directly initiating the orgy, only occasionally making small movements.
target: Non obstante eorum moderatione dissoluta, directe orgiam inire abstinuerunt, tantum interdum parvos motus facientes.

source: If God were watching, He would have incinerated all of them…
target: Si Deus observasset, omnes illos combusisset…

source: As a believer in the Eternal Blazing Sun, Amandina subconsciously wanted to kneel to the side and bow her head in repentance.
target: Ut credens in Sole Aeterno Ardenti, Amandina subconscie voluit ad latus genu flectere et caput in paenitentia inclinare.

source: What a blasphemous scene!
target: Quam sacrilega spectaculum!

source: Holding the open Sun Bible, Padre Cali continued to impart the teachings of the Eternal Blazing Sun to the naked men with an abnormally excited expression.
target: Tenens Biblicam Solarem apertam, Padre Cali continuavit doctrinas Solis Aeterni Ardenti nudis viris cum expressione insolitam excitatae tradere.

source: “God says, the sun shines justly upon everyone…”
target: “Deus dicit: Sol aequo splendore super omnes luceat…”

source: During the preaching, Padre Cali’s gaze frequently swept across Robert and the other purebreds of the Northern Continent, their faces, chests, and lower bodies.
target: Durante praedicatione, oculus Padre Cali saepe transcurrit super Robertum et ceteros puri sanguinis ex Continenti Septentrionali, in vultibus, pectoribus, et inferioribus corporibus.

source: His expression revealed uncontrollable satisfaction, pleasure, and enjoyment.
target: Eius vultus patefecit laetitiam, voluptatem, et gaudium inexsuperabile.

source: Lumian had always felt that he was well-read.
target: Lumian semper existimavit se bene eruditum esse.

source: In the past, he had disrupted the Church’s holy operations, but the scene before him still exceeded his imagination, leaving him momentarily dumbfounded.
target: Olim sacras Ecclesiae operationes turbavit, sed scena ante eum eius imaginationem superabat, eum permomentaneam stupefactum relinquens.

source: Are the padres of the Eternal Blazing Sun Church among the most “outstanding” Intisians?
target: Num sacerdotes Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardenti inter egregios Intisianos existimantur?

source: In an instant, information about Padre Cali and the observations of the past few days appeared in Lumian’s mind.
target: In momento, notitia de Padre Cali et observationes dierum nuperorum in mente Lumiani apparuerunt.

source: He’s a native of Port Pylos, possessing pure West Balam bloodline and a lowly native of the Southern Continent.
target: Ille indigena est Portus Pylosi, sanguinis West Balam purum gerens, et humilis indigena Continenti Meridionali.

source: Starting as a cathedral servant, he had seized the opportunity to change his fate.
target: Servus cathedralis initio factus, occasionem fatum suum mutandi arripuit.

source: Subsequently, he had worked diligently and eventually became the padre of Tizamo Town.
target: Postea diligenter operatus est et tandem factus est Padre oppidi Tizamo.

source: He yearns for higher status and more recognition, especially from those hailing from the Northern Continent…
target: Summam dignitatem et amplam recognitionem desiderat, praesertim a iis oriundis ex Continenti Septentrionali…

source: Such long-standing desires have distorted the desires of Padre Cali.
target: Talia diuturna desideria, desideria Padre Cali, deformaverunt.

source: Is he secretly targeting men from various countries in the Northern Continent, attempting to subdue them and gain his sought‐after recognition?
target: Num arcte, viris ex diversis regionibus Continenti Septentrionali, insidiatur, eos subigere atque agnitionem suam quaesitam adipisci conans?

source: Robert and the others are clearly relatively young.
target: Robert et ceteri plane iuvenes sunt.

source: If Padre Cali had started doing such things a few years ago, they would still have been minors with immature minds.
target: Si Padre Cali talia ante aliquot annos coepisset, adhuc minores cum mentibus immaturis fuissemus.

source: Tsk, you padres…
target: Tsk, o padres…

source: As Lumian analyzed the current situation, he thought of his sister Aurore.
target: Dum Lumian condicionem praesentem analyzabat, de sorore sua Aurore cogitavit.

source: In Cordu, he had not liked entering the cathedral, attending Mass, or praying often.
target: In Cordu, ei non placebat intrare in cathedralem, Missam adire, aut saepe precari.

source: On the one hand, Aurore did not like it herself and set an example.
target: Ex una parte, Aurore ipsa non hoc amabat atque exemplum praebebat.

source: On the other hand, Aurore had always been worried that Lumian, who was only twelve or thirteen years old at the beginning, would be alone with the clergyman in the cathedral.
target: Ex altera parte, Aurore semper sollicita erat ne Lumian, qui initio tantum duodecim vel tredecim annos natus esset, solus cum clerico in cathedralem esset.

source: From time to time, she would use words like “Boys have to protect themselves” and “Many padres like boys.”
target: Interdum verba utebatur ut “Pueri se ipsos protegere debent” et “Multi padres pueros amant.”

source: Suppressing his sudden longing, Lumian looked at Padre Cali, who was still engrossed in his preaching.
target: Subprimens repentinam desiderium, Lumian ad Padre Cali respexit, qui adhuc in sua praedicatione immeritus erat.

source: The more he preached, the more excited he became.
target: Quo magis praedicabat, eo magis excitabatur.

source: Lumian felt that his analysis should be correct.
target: Lumian sensit suam rationem esse rectam.

source: A lengthy holy sermon before a male orgy was clearly not something an ordinary person could come up with and put into practice.
target: Longe sermo sacer coram orgia virili plane non erat aliquid quod homo vulgaris excogitare et in praxi adhibere posset.

source: It was abnormally absurd.
target: Inordinanter absurdum erat.

source: However, considering that Padre Cali yearned for the Northern Continent gentlemen’s recognition, especially given his identity as the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s padre, all of this became self-explanatory!
target: Sed, quod Padre Cali agnitionem virorum Continenti Septentrionali, praesertim suae identitatis ut padre Ecclesiae Solis Aeterni Ardenti, quaerebat, omnia haec se ipsa explanabant!

source: Poor Eternal Blazing Sun and Saint Sien.
target: Pauper Sol Aeternus Ardens et Sanctus Sien.

source: They have become an important prop for Padre Cali’s performance art…
target: Facti sunt munus grave artis scaenicae Padre Cali…

source: Just as Lumian thought this, Padre Cali finally completed his “exciting” sermon.
target: Iam ut Lumian hoc cogitaverat, Padre Cali demum suum sermonem “excitantem” complevit.

source: He spread his arms and shouted, “Praise the Sun!”
target: Bracchia extendit et exclamavit: “Laudate Solem!”

source: Robert and the other lads, equally excited and naked, knelt on the ground, spread their arms, and sang in unison, “Praise the Sun! Praise His Grace!”
target: Robert et ceteri iuvenes, aeque excitati et nudi, genu flecti ad terram, brachia porrigentes, uni voce cantaverunt: “Laudate Solem! Laudate Gratiam Eius!”

source: The Sun does not wish to be praised by you… His Grace… Yes, it aligns with the aspirations of Padre Cali for higher status.
target: Sol non vult a vobis laudari… Gratia Eius… Ita, congruens est cum cupiditatibus Padre Cali ad altiora statuta.

source: In this male orgy, he made all participants view him as an archbishop and preached to them…
target: In hac orgia virili omnes participes fecit eum reputari ut archiepiscopum et eis praedicavit…

source: Finally, he would bestow the boon of God’s holy spirit on these people?
target: Denique benedictionem Spiritus Sancti Dei his hominibus largiturus erat?

source: Lumian seemed to be able to imagine the ensuing scene.
target: Lumian videbatur sequentem scenam imaginari posse.

source: Padre Cali turned around in satisfaction and solemnly placed the Bible back on the altar.
target: Padre Cali se vertit ex satisfactione et sollemniter Bibliam ad altare reposuit.

source: Then, he approached Robert, resembling an archbishop bestowing grace upon his believers.
target: Deinde accessit ad Robertum, quasi archiepiscopus gratia fidelibus largiens.

source: The other men tangled with each other.
target: Ceteri viri inter se implicati sunt.

source: Camus, Rhea, and Lugano, who were observing the cathedral through another stained-glass window, were equally stunned.
target: Camus, Rhea, et Lugano, qui per aliam fenestram vitream cathedralem spectabant, aeque attoniti erant.

source: In particular, Rhea felt as if her eyes, brain, and soul had been tainted despite all her tragic experiences.
target: Praecipue, Rhea sensit quasi oculi, mens, et anima eius, non obstante omnibus tristicis experientiis, corrupti essent.

source: Upon regaining her senses, Rhea’s anger surged.
target: Cum sensus redintegratos, ira Rhea impetum sumpsit.

source: Beside her, Lumian recalled a detail.
target: A juxta eam, Lumian memor fuit quoddam.

source: He lowered his voice and asked Amandina, “When did Robert become lovers with Padre Cali?”
target: Vocem deminuit et Amandina rogavit: “Quando Robert et Padre Cali amatores facti sunt?”

source: Amandina retracted her corrupted gaze and pondered for a moment.
target: Amandina aspectum corruptum retractavit et paulisper meditata est.

source: “More than a year after Padre Cali arrived in Tizamo, about three years ago.”
target: “Plus quam annum postquam Padre Cali Tizamo pervenit, circiter tres annos abhinc.”

source: Lumian frowned and asked, “Did they become lovers in reality, or during the Dream Festival?”
target: Lumian corrupsit faciem et rogavit: “Facti sunt amatores re vera, an tempore Festival Somniorum?”

source: “Of course in reality,” Amandina replied without hesitation.
target: “Certe re vera,” respondit Amandina sine mora.

source: Somethings off…
target: Aliquid non est rectum…

source: Padre Cali had been in Tizamo for over a year.
target: Padre Cali plus quam annum in Tizamo mansit.

source: He should have mellowed, turned restrained, and been devoid of excessive desires and emotions.
target: Debuit remissi factus esse, moderatus, et carens cupiditatibus atque affectibus nimis intensis.

source: Why was he still targeting Robert and the other lads?
target: Cur tamen Robertum et ceteros iuvenes adhuc petebat?

source: From the looks of it, there is something abnormal about Padre Cali, and this abnormality should have been related to the source of the Dream Festival.
target: Ex specie videtur aliquid anomale de Padre Cali, et haec anomalia fonte Festival Somniorum coniuncta esse debuit.

source: That is why he had declared its beginning…
target: Ideo initium eius declaraverat…

source: Just as Lumian thought this, he saw Rhea raise her bow angrily and aim it at the cathedral, where the scene was becoming increasingly unbearable and foul.
target: Iam ut Lumian hoc cogitaverat, vidit Rhea arcum suum irata extollere et ad cathedralem destinare, ubi scena magis magisque intolerabilis et foeda fiebat.

source: Almost simultaneously, the energetic Padre Cali turned his body.
target: Paene simul, Padre Cali, vigore repleto, corpus vertit.

source: Suddenly, Lumian, with one hand in his pocket, saw the native padre with dark brown skin, sunken eyes, and thin black hair.
target: Subito, Lumian, una manu in sinu, vidit patrem indigenum cum cute fusca, oculis depressis, et capillis tenuibus nigricantibus.

source: His naked figure was reflected in Lumian’s eyes.
target: Figura eius nuda in oculis Lumiani reflexa est.

source: He felt a chilling aura emanating from Padre Cali’s body, attempting to completely freeze and replace his spirit.
target: Sentivit frigidam auram e corpore Padre Cali emanare, quae conabatur totum spiritum eius congelare et substituere.

source: Wraith Possession!
target: Possessio Umbrae!

source: So, Padre Cali possesses the ability to transform into a Wraith.
target: Itaque, Padre Cali potestatem habet in umbram transformandi.

source: It is no wonder that when I investigated his weaknesses, I realized that it only existed deep within the body, within the spirit…
target: Non mirum est quod, cum eius infirmitates investigavi, cognovi ea solum in intimo corpore, in spiritu exsistere…

source: Heh heh, a Wraith preaching in the Eternal Blazing Sun cathedral and under the sunlight…
target: Hehe, umbra praedicans in cathedralem Solis Aeterni Ardenti et sub luce solari…

source: Who would have thought such a thing would happen?
target: Quis putaret talem rem futuram esse?

source: Padre Cali’s Wraith powers definitely had not come from drinking potions.
target: Certissime, vires umbrae Padre Cali non potione bibendo ortae sunt.

source: They would definitely have been discovered and purified…
target: Certe inventae et purgatae fuisse debuerunt…

source: A boon?
target: Munus?

source: Lumian came to a realization.
target: Lumian ad intellectionem pervenit.

source: Relying on the strength of his Sequence 5 Spirit Body, Lumian struggled to wrestle control of his body from Padre Cali.
target: Confidens in virtute Corporis Spiritus Ordinati V, Lumian contendit ut corpus suum a Padre Cali eriperet.

source: He was not in a hurry to activate the Blood Emperor’s aura brand.
target: Non festinavit ad activandum insigne aurae Imperatoris Sanguinis.

source: Instead, he looked at Amandina and said with difficulty, word by word, “Let… me… and… Cali… enter a dream…”
target: Pro eo, ad Amandinam respexit et vix, verba per verba, dixit: “Sinite… me… et… Cali… in somnium intrare…”

source: Lumian knew that Amandina’s ability to forcefully pull people into a dream could only be used one-on-one.
target: Lumian sciebat vires Amandinae ad homines in somnium trahendos tantum uno ad unum adhiberi posse.

source: However, Padre Cali was currently attached to him and entangled with his Spirit Body.
target: Sed, Padre Cali nunc ad eum affixus erat et cum corpore spirituali eius implicatus.

source: Perhaps she could treat them as a unit.
target: Fortasse illa eos tamquam unam copulam tractare posset.

source: As for whether Wraiths dreamed, Lumian did not know for now.
target: Quoad an umbrae somniarent, Lumian pro hac causa nesciebat.

source: After all, he still had a backup plan.
target: Postremo, adhuc consilium praevium habebat.

source: With a resounding crash, Rhea’s arrow shattered the stained-glass window, sending shards crashing to the ground.
target: Cum fragore tonitruoso, sagitta Rhea fenestram vitream confractus est, fragmenta in terram iactans.

source: The arrow, entwined with silver-white lightning, crossed a distance of more than ten meters, pierced the location where Padre Cali had been, and nailed it to the wooden table with the candlestick.
target: Sagitta, fulmine argenteo-albo involuta, spatium plus quam decem metrarum transiit, locum ubi Padre Cali fuisset perforavit, et in mensa lignea cum candelabro infixa est.

source: Amidst crackling lightning, the long wooden table shattered and collapsed to the ground, sending burning candles tumbling in all directions.
target: Inter scintillantia fulgura, longa mensa lignea confracta est et in terram corruit, candelabra ardentia in omnes partes volventa.

source: Robert, clearly taken aback by the sudden departure of Padre Cali, reacted.
target: Robert, plane stupefactus propter repentinam discessionem Padre Cali, respondit.

source: He opened his mouth and uttered strange words in a strange language.
target: Os aperuit et verba insolita in lingua ignota edixit.

source: Coo!
target: Coo!

source: Ns if a cold wind from the Feysac Empire’s extreme north blew, a blurry, strange, and inhuman figure materialized out of thin air and burrowed into Robert’s body.
target: Si ventus frigidus ex extremo septentrione Imperii Feysac flat, figura confusa, insolita et inhumana ex nihilo apparuit atque in corpus Roberti insediavit.

source: A layer of armor-like ice materialized on Robert’s body, and a colossal, sharp, and crystalline frost scythe materialized in his hand.
target: Stratum glacie instar armatura in corpore Roberti apparuit, et falx glaciei, ingens, acuta, et crystallina in manu eius manifesta est.

source: Clutching the massive scythe, Robert sprinted toward Rhea, Camus, and the others.
target: Manu falx ingenti complectens, Robert ad Rhea, Camus et ceteros celeriter accurrit.

source: Wherever he passed, the ground froze, and icicles materialized on the walls.
target: Ubicumque transibat, terra congelabatur, et in parietibus glaciei spicula formabantur.

source: On the fourth floor of the Brieu Motel, in a room near the intersection, two figures emerged from behind the curtains as Lumian and his companions made their way to the street where Saint-Sien Cathedral stood.
target: In quarto tabulato Brieu Motel, in conclavi prope angulum, duo figurae e post cortinas eminuerunt, dum Lumian et comites eius viam faciebant ad viam ubi Cathedralis Sancti Sien stabat.

source: One of them was a man with distinct Northern Continent features.
target: Unus ex illis vir erat, cui notas ex Continenti Septentrionali distinctas habebat.

source: His dark-green eyes stood out against his dark gray formal suit and black silk top hat.
target: Oculi eius virides obscuri in veste formali griseo obscuro et pileo serico nigro eminuerunt.

source: The other was a woman with delicate skin, exquisite facial features, and deep blue eyes.
target: Alter erat femina cum cute delicata, lineamentis vultus exquisitis, et oculis caeruleis profundis.

source: She wore a light-colored dress that allowed for easy movement and a feathered hat adorned with pearls.
target: Gestabat vestem pallidam, quae facilem motum permittebat, et pileum pennatum gemmis ornatum.

source: They were the couple Lumian had seen moving into the Brieu Motel late at night.
target: Eram par quem Lumian vidit sero nocte in Brieu Motel ingredi.

source: They had arrived in Tizamo a mere ten minutes before the official Dream Festival began.
target: Ad Tizamo pervenerant tantum decem minuta ante initium Festival Somniorum officialium.

source: At that moment, the man and woman’s eyes were clear, devoid of any excessive emotions or actions.
target: Illo momento, oculi viri et feminae claros erant, carentes omni nimia affectu aut actu.

source: “The patrol team’s sudden arrival in Tizamo is indeed because they discovered the problem here,” the beautiful woman said in a deep voice, gazing out the window at the street below.
target: “Repentina adventus turmae speculatorum in Tizamo re vera quia hic quaestionem invenerunt,” dixit femina formosa voce profunda, per fenestram in viam deorsum contemplans.

source: “From the looks of it, they’ve also found a way to remain lucid and rational in this special dream.”
target: “Ex specie videtur, etiam viam invenisse ut in hoc somnio speciali lucidi et rati maneant.”

source: The man’s expression was cold as he nodded slightly and said, “But they don’t know much yet.
target: Vultus viri frigidus erat dum leviter annuens dixit: “Sed adhuc parum scientes sunt.

source: They’re moving in the wrong direction.”
target: “In directione errata se movere vident.”

source: “Let’s get moving.”
target: “Eamus.”

source: The woman in the feathered hat led the way to the door.
target: Femina pileo pennato viam ad ostium duxit.

source: The two of them descended the stairs swiftly, one after the other.
target: Ambo celeriter de scalis descendere coeperunt, uno post alium.

source: As they passed the second floor, the woman in the light-colored dress suddenly stopped and whispered, “Do you hear something strange?”
target: Dum secundum tabulatum transirebant, femina in veste pallida subito cessavit et susurravit: “Audisne aliquid insolitum?”

source: The man in the half top hat listened intently for a few seconds before hearing faint chewing sounds coming from a room deep on the second floor.
target: Vir cum pileo dimidio attente auscultavit aliquot secundis antequam tenues sonos masticandi ex conclavi profunde in secundo tabulato audiret.

source: The sound persisted without pause..
target: Sonus sine intermissione perseveravit.
